editorial:
If you love a good revenge story, Peppermint delivers exactly what you want. Jennifer Garner plays Riley North, a mom whose husband and daughter are gunned down by a cartel. When the justice system fails her, she disappears for five years and comes back as a trained, deadly vigilante. The movie moves fast, with plenty of shootouts and hand-to-hand fights. Garner is convincing as a grieving mother turned action hero, and the story keeps you rooting for her the whole way. It is not deep or fancy, but it is a solid, satisfying thriller that knows exactly what it is.

The action scenes are the real highlight, with tight pacing and brutal, well-shot fights. On the downside, the villains are pretty flat and the plot follows a familiar formula. Still, if you want a no-nonsense revenge flick with a strong female lead, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Riley storms the cartel's headquarters and kills the boss who ordered her family's murder. She also takes out the corrupt cops and judges who let the killers go free. After a final showdown, she escapes the police and disappears into the night. The movie ends with a tease that she is not done, hinting at more vigilante justice to come. It is a clean, satisfying finish that rewards your patience.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge thrillers and strong female leads.
